concerns.text: T002 reads a 'frozen elemental-property reference table data/raw/elemental_properties.csv' but no task produces it. Where do the atomic radii, electronegativities, valence electrons, and melting points come from? An implementer cannot execute T002 without a source for this table (hand-entered? extracted from a named package?). Add a producer step or name the canonical source.

T003 says hea_descriptors.csv is 'validated row-wise against contracts/descriptor.schema.yaml and contracts/hea_schema.schema.yaml', but the listed columns (alloy_id, composition, five descriptors, yield_strength) do not include hea_schema's required fields (elements, fractions, delta, delta_chi, yield_strength_mpa, is_single_phase, is_room_temp). As specified, row-wise validation against hea_schema.schema.yaml will fail on every row. Specify which schema actually validates the CSV, or specify the columns to match.

T005 mandates '5-fold CV hyperparameter grid search' but names no search space (which hyperparameters, which value grids). An implementer cannot execute this deterministically; either pin the grid (e.g., max_depth, min_samples_leaf values) or drop the grid search and use the fixed hyperparameters the plan specifies.

T008's external set is defined only as 'a second Materials Project query with a disjoint filter (different date range / distinct entry set)'. This is underdetermined: the implementer cannot know which filter to use, and a date-range filter on the same API does not guarantee independence. Specify the concrete filter criteria (or the fallback rule) so the query is reproducible.

T013's verification 'a clean re-run from data/raw/ reproduces all artifacts with identical checksums' conflicts with T001 fetching live API data — a re-fetch may return different records. Clarify that the re-run starts from the already-fetched data/raw/ files (no re-fetch), otherwise the verification is unexecutable as stated.

T012's verification checks section presence via regex, but the claim 'every number in the report has an entry in provenance_linking.json' has no specified check. Name the mechanism (e.g., a test that extracts all numeric tokens from report.md and asserts each has a PV id) so the SC-011 verification is executable.
